title: The S&P 500 just sent a warning signal to investors
title_zh: 标准普尔500指数刚刚向投资者发出警告信号
summary: Amid a week of heightened volatility, the S&P 500 closed below its 50-day moving average for the first time in more than two months.
summary_zh: 在波动加剧的一周内，标准普尔 500 指数两个多月来首次收于 50 日移动均线下方。

title: Why this startup says it can eliminate AI chatbot hallucinations
title_zh: 为什么这家初创公司说它可以消除人工智能聊天机器人的幻觉
summary: Scaled Cognition CEO Dan Roth explains how his company is developing reliable artificial intelligence (AI) models that don't provide false or misleading information.
summary_zh: Scaled Cognition 首席执行官 Dan Roth 解释了他的公司如何开发可靠的人工智能 (AI) 模型，这些模型不会提供虚假或误导性信息。

title: Exclusive-Apple accuses India of 'copy-pasting' rivals' claims in antitrust investigation
title_zh: 独家——苹果指责印度在反垄断调查中“复制粘贴”竞争对手的主张
summary: By Aditya Kalra NEW DELHI, June 29 (Reuters) - Apple has accused Indian antitrust investigators of "copy-pasting" its rivals' claims and failing to properly conduct its own investigation in concluding
summary_zh: 路透新德里 6 月 29 日 - 苹果指责印度反垄断调查人员“复制粘贴”其竞争对手的说法，并且未能正确开展自己的调查以得出结论

title: Analysis-What's good for the US economy now may not be good for stocks
title_zh: 分析-现在对美国经济有利的事情可能对股市不利
summary: By Caroline Valetkevitch and Karen Brettell NEW YORK, June 29 (Reuters) - The U.S. economy and the U.S. stock market are starting to go their own ways.
summary_zh: 作者：Caroline Valetkevitch 和 Karen Brettell 纽约，6 月 29 日（路透社）——美国经济和美国股市开始按自己的方式发展。

title: This is not what a risk-off month usually looks like: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 这不是避险月份通常的样子：每日图表
summary: Many of the market's biggest winners this month are hiding in places investors were not watching a month ago.
summary_zh: 本月市场的许多最大赢家都躲在投资者一个月前没有关注的地方。
